settings.handOver.label: Hand-over
settings.handOver.body: A session's agent may ask to hand its session over to another agent, with a note of where the work stands, kept as its claim. This says whether such an ask waits for your yes or no on the session's page, is taken when the agent's turn ends and goes on with the next agent in your order, or is refused. Your own press hands one over whatever this says. A repository's rule replaces its workspace's.
settings.handOver.says.ask: An agent’s ask to hand its session over waits for your yes or no on the session’s page.
settings.handOver.says.on: An agent’s ask to hand its session over is taken when its turn ends: it goes on with the next agent in your order.
settings.handOver.says.off: An agent’s ask to hand its session over is refused: only your own press hands one over.
settings.handOver.summary.on: hand-overs taken at the turn’s end
settings.handOver.mode: What an agent in {{name}} asking to hand its session over does
settings.handOver.saved.ask: An agent in {{name}} asking to hand its session over now waits for your yes.
settings.handOver.saved.on: An agent in {{name}} asking to hand its session over now goes on with the next agent when its turn ends.
settings.handOver.saved.off: An agent in {{name}} asking to hand its session over is now refused.
settings.handOver.cleared: {{name}} takes its hand-over rule from what stands above it again.
